modelName: White Diamond Production Router — S26 + S30 + S33-A + S28 policy
description: Production routing policy per research/production-quality-white-ml-roadmap.md. Routes between S26 (dense lookup), S30 (supported smooth curves), S33-A (constrained credibility surface), and S28 (monotone fallback).

routingRules.name: dense_lookup
routingRules.condition: S26 lookup level <= 3 AND S26 lookup count >= 5 AND carat < 8
routingRules.reason: dense lookup cell with adequate support

routingRules.name: supported_s30_curve
routingRules.condition: S30 curve exists AND curve.n >= 15 AND carat within [curve.minCarat, curve.maxCarat] AND carat >= 5
routingRules.reason: S30 smooth median curve best for high-carat supported specs

routingRules.name: s33a_anchor
routingRules.condition: S33-A L1 anchor exists AND anchor.n >= 10
routingRules.reason: constrained credibility anchor with monotonicity guarantee

routingRules.name: s28_fallback
routingRules.reason: monotone structural prior as final fallback
